This tutorial derives Kaluza-Klein theories and coset space dimensional reduction from first principles, without omitting steps. It
starts with the abelian theory on a circle, moves to non-abelian theory on the sphere, and then covers coset space dimensional
reduction, before surveying other methods of compactification and reduction.

Start with the [preface](preface.qmd) and the [conventions](conventions.qmd). The background is in two
companion tutorials: [Fundamentals of Mathematics for Physicists](../fundamentals-of-mathematics-for-physicists/index.qmd) and
[Fundamentals of Theoretical Physics](../fundamentals-of-theoretical-physics/index.qmd). Links in the chapters take you to the results
they use.
